name: Mills Industries
old_description: OVER four Mills family generations, it has been our honor to continue to be considered a pioneer in packaging technology and advancements, an unwavering adaptor to the ever changing needs of the industries we serve and a name that the customers we partner with know and trust.
about:
Mills Industries has operated from Laconia, New Hampshire since its founding in 1972. The company remains family owned and operated, now spanning four generations of the Mills family. It began as a packaging operation and has evolved into a specialist in corrugated plastic solutions.

The company designs and manufactures custom corrugated plastic packaging for a range of applications. Its product lines include marketing and display packaging, trays and totes, industrial containers and material handling systems, plastic partitions and parts dividers, collapsible boxes and cartons, and specialized packaging for life sciences and cleanroom environments. No facility size or headcount figures are publicly disclosed.

Mills Industries serves customers in life sciences, cleanroom manufacturing, industrial manufacturing, material handling, and marketing and display sectors. The company does not name specific clients in its public materials.

The firm describes itself as a pioneer in packaging technology and advancements, emphasizing its ability to adapt to changing industry needs. Its longevity and family ownership are presented as foundations for the trust its partners place in the Mills name.
